failure.message: Browser inspection callbacks may inspect results only; use Playwright locators for control interaction.

sourceReferences.fact: The callback guard regex treats an equals sign followed by > as assignment while scanning for forbidden DOM writes.
readProposalPreviewDocument only reads DOM fields and uses a local pure `clean = value =>` formatter.
The workflow obtains the proposal response and checks protocol rows before calling inspect(readProposalPreviewDocument); DOM-level receipt/schema/row checks were blocked.

failure.interpretation: Harness-only pre-lifecycle-to-Pivot verification blocker. Native/API requests completed without errors; the remainder of Pivot and RELATED_SOURCE Cancel/Apply/edit/removal/reload was not exercised.
